trigger: after seeing zero stations with four potential complete date-label years in the preselected 2010-2020 interval
expanded_calendar_years: 1985-2021 inclusive, the full published dataset metadata time extent; all 248 already-frozen station IDs
purpose: explore whether older, still retrospective reference years may support the separate leave-one-year-out annual comparison; not the preselected post-2010 prospective cohort
strict_rule_unchanged: at least four completely observed 24-hour, nonestimated quality-qualified reference years and three other years for local fitting
data_read_before_amendment: station metadata, all source activity date labels through the 2010-2020 filter and aggregate result; no water temperatures or model errors were examined
limitation: post-hoc expansion and outcome-informed availability search; cannot be presented as preregistered, climate-independent, or a population sampling rate
